'''Rose''' (Japanese: '''ヤオヘイカミさん''' ''Yaohei's wife'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG068|A Double Dilemma]]'', and the wife of [[Yaohei]]. She did not receive an official name in the Japanese version.

A resident of [[North Petalburg]], Rose, like everyone else in North Petalburg, is obsessed with [[Petalburg City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Norman]] and his family. She was one of the first to notice that {{an|May}} and [[Max]] had returned while delivering some food supplies to the local [[Pokémon Center]]. Excited at the thought of Norman's children being in the area, Rose immediately contacted [[Dee Dunstan|the press]] and everybody else in town so they could see the children. She led the crowd's fanfare, requesting that May perform several {{pkmn|Coordinator}} moves.

Rose was also one of the people who started booing {{Ash}} when he gained the upper hand in a {{pkmn|battle}} against May. Later in the episode she got in a fight with Yaohei because he said the May and Max she saw were fakes and that the ones he saw were [[Team Rocket trio|the real ones]].
